reference_summary: This First Amendment to the Amended and Restated Limited Partnership Agreement of Horizon Equity Partners IV, L.P., a Delaware limited partnership, is dated July 15, 2024 and follows the fund’s final closing on that date; it confirms total committed capital of $500,000,000, with an initial closing of January 15, 2024, an investment period through January 15, 2029, and termination on January 15, 2034. Schedule A is replaced to reflect final partners and commitments: Horizon Alpha GP, LLC ($5,000,000), Global Pension Systems ($150,000,000), Sovereign Wealth Authority ($120,000,000), Metropolitan Insurance Group ($100,000,000), University Endowment Fund ($75,000,000), and Riverside Family Office ($50,000,000), totaling 100.0%; the amendment also states which LPs are tax-exempt and that all LPs are accredited investors and qualified purchasers. The amendment clarifies the management fee as 2.0% during the investment period on aggregate committed capital and 1.5% thereafter on invested capital, subject to a 100% fee income offset; it also states no fee waivers have been granted, no placement agent has been engaged, and the organizational expense cap remains $500,000 with approximately $387,000 incurred as of final closing. It confirms a European / Whole Fund waterfall with an 8.0% compounded preferred return, 100% GP catch-up, 20% carried interest, 8.0% subsequent closing interest, and a 30% clawback escrow. It also confirms allocation methods are generally pro rata by capital commitments, reporting deadlines of 45 days quarterly, 120 days annually, and 10 business days for capital call and distribution notices, while providing that all other terms of the original agreement remain in effect and Delaware law governs.
